visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200. Avoid heavy shadows. Use soft shadows only on hover.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-lg for cards, rounded-full for pills and avatars.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for default cards, shadow-md on hover. No muddy shadows.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High density. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. p-8 for main dashboard container.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar with clearly defined active states (blue-50 bg with blue-600 text and left border).

components.cards: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px border. No glassmorphism on the dashboard data cards to maintain clarity.
components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast. Primary uses bg-blue-600 text-white.
components.charts: Use Shadcn charts (recharts). Minimalist axes, prominent data lines/bars in blue and indigo.
components.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers. Highlight alternating rows lightly if needed. Use Shadcn table.
components.badges: Soft background with strong text (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800).

motion.hover: Subtle transform -translate-y-[2px] for cards, fast color transitions (0.15s ease) for buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements. e.g., data-testid='kpi-total-students'

3d_libraries.reasoning: This is a high-density, multi-tenant ERP/Dashboard for schools. Clarity, speed, and tabular data visualization are prioritized over 3D immersion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Left Sidebar layout with a top header. The sidebar should contain links to Dashboard, Students, Staff, Attendance, Fees, Exams, Complaints.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) or Lucide-react for all menu items and KPI cards.
For the Principal Dashboard, build KPI Cards: Total Enrolled Students (with +XX this month), Today's Attendance %, Total Pending Fee Collections, Active Teachers Present, Open Complaints.
Below KPIs, include a Monthly Fee Collection chart (Bar chart) and a recent student admissions/complaints table.
For the QR ID cards feature, build a printable view component that lays out student details compactly.
Use standard Radix UI / Shadcn UI components for dropdowns, selects, and dialogs. No raw HTML <select> elements.
Implement Sonner for all toast notifications (e.g., 'Fee reminder sent successfully').
Ensure the dashboard feels 'premium' by avoiding excessive shadows and relying instead on crisp 1px borders and generous padding (p-6) within cards.
Do not use full transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined Outfit/IBM Plex Sans typography.
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties only.
Do not center-align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md with focus rings).
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Add micro-animations for hover states and staggered entrance.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
